appStore.name: Lissom: Movement Checks
appStore.subtitle: Explore movement tests
appStore.promotionalText: Browse movement-test descriptions and measurement limits. Camera assessments and subscriptions are not open in this release.

playStore.shortDescription: Explore movement tests and their limits; camera assessments are not open.

description:
Lissom is a general wellness catalogue of movement tests. Explore Overhead Reach, Deep Squat, Active Straight Leg Raise and the other listed tests. Each page explains what the measurement work covers and where it is still incomplete.

In this first release, you can browse without signing in and create an optional shared Motion account. Camera assessments, dated measurement results, yoga lessons and subscriptions are not available.

The Motion account uses your email address, account ID and an optional display name. Account deletion is available in the app. Lissom is not a medical device and does not diagnose or treat any condition.
$sourceOfFacts: Current camera capability: docs/evidence/production-line/assessment-capabilities.json (3 live / 12 listed); live test IDs overhead_reach, deep_squat, active_straight_leg_raise. Local history: lib/app/live_capture_screen.dart, lib/app/local_account_bridge.dart, test/measurement_persistence_test.dart. Optional account/remote data: lib/main.dart and shared motion_account_client.dart. Recheck after courses or privacy behavior changes.
$notClaimed: No physical-device performance or twelve-test coverage claim. Real-device A12 acceptance and provider metadata readback remain open. Live Motion privacy policy content lacks Lissom account data and retention details (2026-09-24 curl readback); update before submission. This is a local draft, not a submission.
